title: Raw projected junta restriction batch
statement: Let $n$, $M$, and $R$ be natural numbers, let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $[n]$, and fix a sign assignment on $P$. Given a sequence of $R$ inputs from the sign cube, the raw projected junta restriction batch is either undefined or a sequence of $M$ pairs, each consisting of an assignment on the coordinates outside $P$ and a sign, obtained by selecting matching labeled examples and projecting them to the restriction determined by the fixed assignment.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the matching criterion or the projection operation, so their exact behavior cannot be stated.
